Apr △, Post-Race | Wind: Lukewarm "To 
Carve That Name into the Vast Ocean" 
========================================

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Shakur and I both lost the Satsuki Sho. 
But races are always a gamble on the day. 
It's best to just laugh it off!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
I didn't win, but that's not too bad. I 
made sure to get my name out there. Got to 
keep aggressively selling myself at this 
rate!
